reasoning: On the season so far the Knicks are the stronger team; with home court the Knicks start about 9 points better, in a game of about 229 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Bulls.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Bulls (revenge, confidence).
Bottom line: the Knicks win 70 times in 100, by about 7; most games like this end between 204 and 253 total points.
